name: Bram
title: Tallyman of the Boom
examine: He counts the logs in and he counts the logs out. He has done this for nineteen years and can describe all of them.
lines: Wet count and dry count. They should match. Twice this year they have not.
Nineteen years. I have the books for all of it if you want to see them.
Some people find this dull. I find it restful.
